author: National Geographic
description:
How does hash smuggling work? Join National Geographic in this episode of Trafficked as Mariana van Zeller tracks the illicit path of hashish from Morocco into Europe — a world of shadowy dealers, lightning-fast smuggling boats, and endless wealth.

Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller | S4 E7

Chapters:
00:00 - Introduction to Hash Smuggling
01:32 - Return to Portugal 
06:00 - Investigation in Morocco
09:56 - Inside a Traditional Hashish Farm 
16:51 - Chasing Contacts in Morocco
18:41 - Port of Algeciras
21:40 - High-Speed ocean Pursuit
27:05 - High Stakes & Economics of Smuggling
30:45 - Interviewing the "Devil's Advocate" Lawyer
32:55 - Meeting an Ex-Smuggler in Spain
36:45 - Meeting "El Cisne," The Hash Queen
